jobs.af2c1b85d1f6: unclear: a noun or function word in a sentence introducing an upcoming example, code, figure or template ("looks like", "the following HTML", "input and output", "Figure 1") in technical text.
jobs.90918c2dd65b: Fires on a token that ends a heading or reference line: a newline after a title, "see" in "see:", "Window" in "Opens New Window", or the ".com"/".org" of an email.
jobs.a73afca76c98: Fires on an early word in the first sentence or title of a document (the 2nd to 6th token), mostly the word after a subject noun, such as "is", "be defined", "of".
jobs.1e024b4e14ed: Fires on a word-piece inside a word in a comma-separated list of tags, keywords or terms, often the start or middle of a split word (" ey", " cob", " Paras").
jobs.3ca174288d70: A digit or space right before a digit inside a number: year digits (1⟦9⟧11), section numbers and the space before "1", mostly the token before the final digits.
jobs.a8a81f8e0804: Fires on a preposition or determiner right after a noun or verb phrase, especially "at", "to", "this", "present", "same" in the middle of a sentence ("at a velocity", "at the same time").
jobs.f12997e0806d: A token that opens or ends a clause detail: "(" or a comma after a noun, "into", "such as", "choose", where a list, split or example is about to follow.
jobs.7cac9536346d: A comma, dash or "and" that joins an adjective or clause mid-sentence in news-style prose, such as "—" or "–" before an elaboration, or a comma between stacked adjectives.
jobs.3b6b415e6c51: The word after a first word in educational web page text about lessons and links: "plan" in "lesson plan", "out" in "find out", "to" in "introduces you to".
jobs.3076e70c42a8: Last token of a name, acronym, year or place phrase, or a comma after a short intro clause ("191⟦1⟧", "(ANI⟦)", "Sultan Ahmed⟦ Mosque⟧"); the word completing a named entity.
jobs.e58f2d37931b: unclear: a word following a verb or noun of reading or writing such as "Written By", "read more", "Portrait" (as in National Portrait), "image", "symbol".
jobs.353aec0d8bdd: A newline or "?\n" at the end of a title or question heading, right before the body text starts ("Parkinson's disease?\n").
jobs.f6208b648a9a: The "|" table-cell separator (or a newline-then-pipe) in wikitext infobox tables, right after a title line or at the start of a table row.
jobs.03fbcd5c3756: A plural noun or verb that is the head of a phrase introducing a list or definitions: "terms are", "numbers", "rates were", "definitions", "as follows" right before the listed items.
jobs.e5b7cdc67889: Punctuation or separator in a date or metadata line (comma after a day, "|", ":", " -", newline), often in timestamps, bylines or citation records.
jobs.a9653a412e8c: unclear: a mid-sentence content word or word piece in a definitional health or science sentence ("is a change", "important part", "ex⟦cret⟧ed"), usually after an article or adjective.
jobs.2937d324e23f: A past-participle or verb-like word following an auxiliary or adverb ("aren't referenced", "is wrapped", "was brought", "are thought"), the main verb of a passive or perfect phrase.
jobs.9a22605be7c6: The last or only token of a noun inside a noun phrase in health, science or news prose, often a word ending ("acid", "attack", "diplomas", "printing", "body").
jobs.68b45a38c9e6: A hyphen "-" bullet starting a list item at line start, or a colon after a term at line start in a definition list ("multitree:", "Stephen Hawking:").
jobs.39b924f87586: A comma or word after a short quoted foreign term or in a medical instruction ("telo⟦,⟧ meaning", "or higher", "see a doctor", "talk with"), where a gloss or advice follows.
jobs.af2dd55a54c3: unclear: a function word or connector mid-clause in informal prose ("make that", "at", "of", "if", "the"), with no stable context.
jobs.c671b229c4a3: A word right after a negation or quantifier in health or science text ("not harmful", "no early symptoms", "do not interfere with"), or after "Exams and".
jobs.b577a659dccf: The word "short" or similar small-size adjective or noun ("short", "brief", "flash", "snatch", "tidbits", "snapshot") in the middle of a phrase.
jobs.09aaeb28250a: A dash or apostrophe-like punctuation ("—", "–", "--", "`", "’") used mid-sentence as a break or contraction mark.
jobs.3338100dfde8: A word piece in the middle of a longer or misspelled word, URL or code fragment ("my⟦raid⟧", "th⟦ier⟧", "y⟦r⟧", "co-⟦ordinate⟧"), plus stray function words.
jobs.b9d1bb0bf4f2: The token "@example" in a masked email address "firstname.lastname@example.org", right after "lastname".
jobs.22b65387630d: The word "and" joining two clauses after a subject-clause with an "if", "given" or "as" opener ("If you do X and Y", "in a world with Z and").
jobs.22f5ade0bb36: A comma or period right after a name, abbreviation or month at the start of a byline or dateline ("Nov⟦.⟧ 6", "By Karen Gonzales⟦,⟧", "(PhysOrg⟦.com⟧)").
jobs.1f507504692f: unclear: a space or punctuation token right before the year or a digit in a dated line ("March 17,⟦ ⟧2003", "November 17⟦ ⟧2012"), also "?\n" after a heading.
jobs.f7f7eed13957: A single digit or a decimal point inside a number or random character string ("13⟦.⟧5", "17⟦.⟧5", "1⟦9⟧8", URL or password characters), mid-number.
